item.title: Kabukiza Theatre — Guide
item.description: The Kabukiza in Ginza is Tokyo’s principal theatre for kabuki, Japan’s flamboyant and highly stylised traditional stage art, blending drama, dance, music and spectacle with elaborate costumes, dramatic make-up and all-male casts. The current grand building, its imposing traditional-style facade a Ginza landmark, reopened in 2013 above a modern tower and shopping complex. Kabuki performances are famously long — full programmes can run for hours across multiple acts — but the Kabukiza thoughtfully sells ‘single-act’ tickets (hitomaku-mi) that let visitors watch just one act relatively cheaply, a perfect way to sample the art without committing to a whole day.
